issues.explanation: Exactly-once skip is broken: on stale status the loop continues without excluding that id, retrying the same ordered SELECT forever instead of picking the next candidate.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the new action, violating the no-production-code-without-a-test gate.
Task rule 9 requires documenting Call the next ticket in both docs files, but the diff updates neither.
Manually mutates status/called_at/called_by_user_id plus save() instead of reusing the existing Ticket::call() transition, risking divergence from the write-once rule.

review.summary: Adds the CallMode enum, NoWaitingTicketsException, and CallNextTicket action with correct filtering, ordering, fairness, and inactive-queue handling. Needs substantial rework before merging because the concurrency skip loops forever, no tests ship, docs are not updated, and the ticket mutation duplicates Ticket::call().
